phase_name: Measurement Workflow Launch Authorization Candidate Final Evidence Lock Report Design
phase_japanese_name: 測定ワークフロー起動許可候補の最終証跡固定レポート設計
purpose: Design the final evidence locking and authorization signature workflow for Phase 18-7 final judgment, establishing immutable record of pre-execution readiness declaration before Phase 15-7 and 15-8 measurement workflow launch authorization

scope_1_launch_authorization_preparation.description: Prepare Phase 18-7 final judgment result for authority review and authorization signature

step_1_receive_phase18_7_judgment.action: Receive Phase 18-7 final judgment report with 6 sections (aggregates, evidence verification, failure remediation, abort conditions, judgment declaration)
judgment_content_to_verify: Phase 18-2 results (Phase 15-7 checks: READY_TO_EXECUTE | HOLD | HALT)
Phase 18-3 results (Phase 15-8 checks: READY_TO_EXECUTE | HOLD | HALT)
Phase 18-4 evidence lock verification (hash, signature, audit trail integrity)
Phase 18-5 failure remediation status (none, in progress, completed, escalated)
step_1_receive_phase18_7_judgment.validation_gate: Phase 18-7 report must be complete, consistent, and signed by executing authority

step_2_serialize_judgment_for_locking.action: Serialize Phase 18-7 final judgment into canonical JSON format for hash computation
serialization_rules: JSON fields in alphabetical order (deterministic serialization)
No whitespace variations (use compact JSON with no extra spaces)

step_3_compute_judgment_evidence_hash.action: Compute SHA-256+ hash of serialized Phase 18-7 final judgment
step_3_compute_judgment_evidence_hash.verification: Hash must be deterministic; re-serialization and re-hashing must produce identical hash

step_4_create_launch_authorization_candi.action: Create immutable launch authorization candidate record (awaiting authority signature)

record_structure.authority_reviewer_expected_role: Technical authority who approved Phase 18-2 and Phase 18-3 (or escalated authority)

scope_2_authority_review_and_signature.description: Authority review of Phase 18-7 final judgment and digital signature generation

step_1_authority_receives_candidate.action: Authority receives launch authorization candidate with Phase 18-7 judgment for review
review_checklist: Phase 18-2 check results: all 8 checks reviewed, status understood
Phase 18-3 check results: all 8+ checks reviewed, Phase 15-7 integration understood
Phase 18-4 evidence locks: integrity verified (hash, signature, audit trail)
Phase 18-5 remediation status: failures (if any) remediated or escalated appropriately
Phase 18-6 abort conditions: all clear or detected conditions documented
Phase 18-7 final judgment rationale: decision logic (Precedence 1/2/3) verified as correct

step_2_authority_decision_options.action: Authority makes authorization decision based on review

decision_options.condition: Phase 18-7 final judgment = PROCEED AND all review checks pass
decision_options.meaning: Authority approves launch of both Phase 15-7 AND Phase 15-8 measurement workflows

decision_options.condition: Phase 15-7 checks READY but Phase 15-8 blockers or Phase 15-7 dependency concerns exist
decision_options.meaning: Authority approves Phase 15-7 launch only (sequential mode). Phase 15-8 deferred pending Phase 15-7 results.

decision_options.condition: Phase 15-8 checks READY but Phase 15-7 blockers or resource constraints exist
decision_options.meaning: Authority approves Phase 15-8 launch only. Phase 15-7 deferred.

decision_options.condition: Phase 18-7 final judgment = HOLD or HALT, or authority decides additional review needed
decision_options.meaning: Authority witholds authorization. Defer launch or escalate to higher authority.

step_3_authority_documents_decision.action: Authority documents authorization decision with rationale

documentation_content.decision_rationale: Explanation of why this decision was made (e.g., all gates clear, some blockers present, risk assessment)

scope_3_digital_signature_generation.description: Generate authority digital signature for launch authorization

step_1_signature_input_preparation.action: Prepare input data for digital signature

step_2_sign_with_authority_private_key.action: Authority signs prepared input using private key
step_2_sign_with_authority_private_key.algorithm: RSA-2048 with SHA-256 or ECDSA-256 with SHA-256

signature_metadata.signer_public_key_identifier: Fingerprint or ID of signer's public key (for verification)

step_4_store_signed_record_in_audit_trai.action: Store signed authorization record in immutable audit trail
step_4_store_signed_record_in_audit_trai.access_control: Read-only; Write-only via Phase 18-8 signature procedure

scope_4_launch_authorization_verificatio.description: Verify signed launch authorization is valid and ready for Phase 15-7/15-8 launch execution

step_1_signature_validity_verification.action: Verify authority signature is cryptographically valid
verification_steps: Retrieve signer's public key using signer_public_key_id
Use public key to verify signature matches reconstructed input
Verify signature algorithm matches declared (RSA-2048 or ECDSA-256)

step_2_authority_validity_verification.action: Verify authority was valid at time of signature
verification_checks: Confirm authority identifier exists in authorization system
Confirm authority was ACTIVE at decision_timestamp_utc (not revoked, disabled, deactivated)
Confirm authority has permission to approve Phase 15-7 and/or Phase 15-8 execution
Confirm authority's public key was valid for signing at decision_timestamp_utc

step_3_signature_expiry_verification.action: Verify signature has not expired and is still within validity period
step_3_signature_expiry_verification.verification_check: Confirm current_utc < signature_valid_to_utc AND signature_valid_from_utc <= current_utc

step_4_revocation_status_verification.action: Verify signature has not been revoked or superseded
step_4_revocation_status_verification.revocation_check: Query revocation authority for signature_id to confirm revocation_status = ACTIVE

step_5_authorization_decision_consistenc.action: Verify authorized workflows match Phase 18-7 judgment
consistency_checks: If Phase 18-7 PROCEED: Authority decision must be AUTHORIZE_FULL | AUTHORIZE_[15_7|15_8]_ONLY
If Phase 18-7 HOLD: Authority decision must be WITHHOLD or approved after remediation
If Phase 18-7 HALT: Authority decision must be WITHHOLD

all_checks_pass.action: Signed authorization is cryptographically valid and authority intact. Ready for Phase 15-7/15-8 launch.

signature_verification_fails.action: ABORT. Signature tampering suspected. Require fresh signature from authority.

authority_revoked_or_invalid.action: ABORT. Authority revoked or invalid. Require new signature from current valid authority.

signature_expired.action: ABORT. Authorization expired. Require fresh signature from authority within current time window.

decision_inconsistent.action: ABORT. Authority decision conflicts with Phase 18-7 judgment. Authority review and re-signature required.

phase_18_8_completion_criteria: Launch authorization preparation procedure (4 steps) designed
Authority review and signature procedure (3 steps) designed
Digital signature generation procedure (4 steps) designed
Launch authorization verification procedure (5 verification steps) designed
4 signature verification outcomes with appropriate actions designed
No changes to app/ or tests/ directories
